chapter.title: Support routines
chapter.para: The hypervisor has the routines of the C library that it needs, which it shares with the JetOS kernel.

section.para: The hypervisor shall provide, for itself, the routines that copy and fill memory and the formatted output to its console, with the behaviour of the C standard for the conversions that they have.

formalpara.title: Rationale
formalpara.para: The hypervisor cannot use the library of another program.

section.para: The hypervisor shall provide the computation of the CRC-32 of a block of bytes (the polynomial of zlib and Ethernet).

formalpara.title: Rationale
formalpara.para: The check of the image is made with it.
